school: 二十世纪粒子物理的对称立法者与中美科学桥梁的总工程师：1926 年生于上海，祖籍苏州，战时辗转赣州联中、浙江大学（师从束星北、王淦昌）、西南联大（师从吴大猷、叶企孙），1946 年经吴大猷举荐赴芝加哥大学，成为费米的博士生；1950 年以白矮星氢含量论文获博士，1951-1953 在普林斯顿高等研究院与 Berkeley，1953 年起任哥伦比亚大学教授直至荣休；1956 年与杨振宁发表《弱相互作用中的宇称守恒质疑》，指出宇称守恒在弱作用中从未被实验检验过，并提出用极化核β衰变中的赝标量直接测量左右不对称——同年吴健雄的钴-60 实验证实，1957 年两人获诺贝尔物理学奖，李时年 31 岁，是当时最年轻的诺奖得主；其一生科学版图横跨统计物理相变（杨李定理、二维伊辛模型的严格结果）、李模型、非拓扑性孤立子与孤立子星、时间反演与 CP 破坏、真空作为量子多体系统的激发、以及推动 RHIC 相对论重离子对撞机建设——贯穿全部工作的主线是：对称不是物理的装饰而是物理的语法，而最深的问题藏在对称破缺之处；1970 年代起他致力于中美科学交流：1974 年向毛泽东建议设立少年班，促成中美高能物理合作与北京正负电子对撞机，建议设立国家自然科学基金与博士后制度，1979-1989 年间创立并主持 CUSPEA 考试，近千名中国学生经此赴美攻读物理博士；1996 年夫人秦惠䇹病逝后设䇹政基金资助两岸青年学者；2024 年 8 月 4 日病逝旧金山——他证明：一个人可以同时为一门学科与世界两边的对话立法
historical_significance: 李政道（Tsung-Dao Lee，1926-2024），1926 年 11 月 24 日生于上海，祖籍江苏苏州，祖父为苏州圣约翰堂首任华人牧师；抗战中中学未毕业，1943 年以同等学历考入内迁贵州的浙江大学物理系，师从束星北、王淦昌；1944 年日军入黔，浙大停学，1945 年转入昆明西南联大为二年级生，师从吴大猷——吴大猷回忆他'每日来我处，要我给他更多的阅读物和习题，求知心切真到了奇怪的程度'；1946 年经吴大猷举荐（与朱光亚同为政府选派学物理的两个名额）赴芝加哥大学，未持本科学位而入研究生院，师从费米；1950 年以白矮星氢含量的天体物理论文获博士学位，与杨振宁、Mayer 等合作转向统计物理相变与凝聚态（极化子）；1951-1953 年先后在普林斯顿高等研究院与加州大学伯克利分校；1953 年任哥伦比亚大学助理教授，1956 年升正教授，此后五十九年在哥大度过；1956 年春，θ-τ之谜（两种质量寿命全同而宇称相反的粒子）悬而未决，李与杨在分析中发现了关键的空白：宇称守恒在强作用中确有严格证据，在弱作用中却从未被任何实验真正检验；同年 10 月二人发表《弱相互作用中的宇称守恒质疑》，提出以极化核β衰变中赝标量 <σ·p> 的测量直接判定左右对称；在他们的建议下吴健雄与美国标准局的安伯勒等做极化钴-60 β衰变实验，1957 年初证实宇称在弱作用中不守恒——泡利事前断言'我不相信上帝是弱左撇子'，事后承认震惊；1957 年 10 月李与杨获诺贝尔物理学奖，李时年 31 岁，为当时最年轻得主（纪录保持近六十年）；此后他继续开拓：与杨合作的统计力学杨李定理与二维伊辛模型自发磁化的严格处理（1952）、李模型（1954，可严格求解的场论模型）、非拓扑性孤立子与孤立子星（1970 年代起，与 Friedberg 等）、真空作为不可对角化量子多体系统的'真空激发'思想、CP 与时间反演破坏的深入分析；他晚年推动美国 RHIC 相对论重离子对撞机的科学论证，追求以重离子对撞重建夸克-胶子等离子体；1970 年代起转向中美科学制度建设：1974 年当面向毛泽东建议仿体育模式设大学少年班（中科大少年班由此而立），促成中美高能物理联合委员会与北京正负电子对撞机的建设，力促国家自然科学基金与博士后制度的建立；1979-1989 年主持 CUSPEA（中美联合招考物理留学生）考试，以个人奔走协调北美七十余所大学，送出近千名博士生，为改革初期人才断层架桥；1996 年夫人秦惠䇹去世后以积蓄设䇹政基金；1958 年 32 岁当选中央研究院院士（至今最年轻）；2024 年 8 月 4 日病逝旧金山，享年 97 岁——他身后留下的是一门以对称与破缺为语法的物理学，与一条他用二十年亲自丈量过的太平洋通道
historical_significance_en: Tsung-Dao Lee (1926-2024) was born in Shanghai on 24 November 1926, his ancestral home Suzhou; his grandfather was the first Chinese pastor of Suzhou's St. John's Church. The war left him without a secondary-school diploma; in 1943 he entered the physics department of Zhejiang University, evacuated to Guizhou, studying under Shu Xingbei and Wang Ganchang; when the Japanese entered Guizhou in 1944 the university shut down, and in 1945 he transferred to the National Southwestern Associated University in Kunming as a second-year student under Wu Ta-You — who recalled that 'every day he came to me demanding more books and more problems; his hunger to learn reached a strange pitch'. In 1946, on Wu's recommendation (one of only two physics places in the government's scheme), he left for the University of Chicago, entering graduate school without a bachelor's degree, as Fermi's doctoral student. He took his PhD in 1950 on the hydrogen content of white dwarfs, then worked with Yang and others on statistical phase transitions and condensed matter (polarons); after the Princeton Institute for Advanced Study and Berkeley he joined Columbia University in 1953 as assistant professor, was made full professor in 1956, and stayed fifty-nine years. In the spring of 1956 the theta-tau puzzle — two particles of identical mass and lifetime but opposite parity — hung unresolved, and Lee and Yang found the crucial blank: parity conservation was rigorously established for the strong interaction but had never once been tested in the weak. Their October 1956 paper, 'Question of Parity Conservation in Weak Interactions', proposed measuring the pseudoscalar <sigma·p> in beta decay of polarized nuclei; at their suggestion Chien-Shiung Wu with Ambler of the National Bureau of Standards ran the polarized cobalt-60 experiment, which early in 1957 showed parity broken in the weak interaction — Pauli, who had wagered 'I do not believe God is a weak left-hander', conceded his astonishment. In October 1957 Lee and Yang shared the Nobel Prize in Physics; Lee, at thirty-one, was the youngest laureate then on record, a record that stood for decades. He went on: the Yang-Lee theorem and the rigorous treatment of spontaneous magnetization in the two-dimensional Ising model (1952), the solvable Lee model of field theory (1954), nontopological solitons and soliton stars (from the 1970s, with Friedberg), the vacuum as an un-diagonalizable quantum many-body system, deep analyses of CP and time-reversal violation, and the scientific case for the Relativistic Heavy Ion Collider (RHIC), chasing the quark-gluon plasma in heavy-ion collisions. From the 1970s he turned to institution-building between China and America: in 1974 he proposed to Mao Zedong, face to face, gifted-education classes on the model of athletic training (the USTC special classes for gifted youth); he brokered Sino-American high-energy cooperation and the Beijing Electron-Positron Collider, pressed for the National Natural Science Foundation and the postdoctoral system; from 1979 to 1989 he ran the CUSPEA examinations, personally coordinating more than seventy North American universities and sending nearly a thousand doctoral students across the Pacific. After his wife Jean Hui-Chun Chin died in 1996 he founded the Chun-Tsung Endowment from his own savings. Elected to Academia Sinica at thirty-two (still the youngest), he died in San Francisco on 4 August 2024, aged ninety-seven — leaving behind a physics whose grammar is symmetry and its breaking, and a Pacific channel he had personally measured for twenty years.
unique_thinking: 李政道的独特处在于三重'对称的操盘'：第一，审讯公理——θ-τ之谜面前他不问'哪种粒子'而问'哪条定律从未被检验'，把全行业公认的宇称守恒翻出来逐条对账，发现它在弱作用里只是从未出庭的默认条款——他证明最深的问题往往不在答案而在前提的检验记录；第二，最小实验否决最大教条——他不重写理论框架，只设计一个能直接测量左右不对称的赝标量实验，让吴健雄的钴-60 在几周内处决一条'普适定律'——他证明打倒教条不需要更大的教条，只需要一个干净的测量；第三，把对称与破缺当成同一枚硬币——从宇称破缺、CP 破缺到真空激发与孤立子，他一生的工作都站在'对称在哪里失效'这个缝隙上，并把它扩展成方法论：完美是值得怀疑的，破缺是信息的来源；此外他是'科学制度的工程师'：CUSPEA、少年班、自然科学基金、博士后制度、北京对撞机——他证明学者的最高产出可以是一门学科加一座桥
unique_thinking_en: Lee's singularity is a triple manipulation of symmetry. First, interrogating the axiom: before the theta-tau puzzle he asked not 'which particle?' but 'which law has never been tested?', auditing parity conservation line by line and finding that in the weak interaction it was only a default clause that had never appeared in court — the deepest problems lie not in answers but in the examination record of one's premises. Second, the minimal experiment to veto the largest dogma: he did not rewrite the theoretical framework; he designed one clean measurement of left-right asymmetry, a pseudoscalar, and Wu's cobalt-60 executed a 'universal law' within weeks — to bring down a dogma one needs no bigger dogma, only one clean measurement. Third, symmetry and its breaking as one coin: from parity violation through CP violation to vacuum excitation and solitons, all his work stands in the crack where symmetry fails, and he expanded that crack into a method — perfection is what deserves suspicion; breaking is where the information lives. He was also the engineer of scientific institutions: CUSPEA, the gifted classes, the science foundation, the postdoctoral system, the Beijing collider — proof that a scholar's highest output can be a discipline and a bridge at once.
civilization_zh: 二十世纪中叶的纽约与普林斯顿——一个从上海经战火中的贵阳、昆明辗转赴美的青年，二十九岁与杨振宁一起推翻了被物理学界公认为放之四海皆准的宇称守恒定律，三十一岁成为当时最年轻的诺贝尔奖得主：他此后半个世纪坚守哥伦比亚大学，以'对称'与'破缺'为母题把粒子物理从θ-τ之谜一路推向相对论重离子对撞，晚年又以 CUSPEA 考试把近千名中国青年物理学家送过大洋——他就是证明'最深的物理学往往是对称在哪里失效'的人
civilization_en: New York and Princeton from the mid-twentieth century on — a young man who traveled from Shanghai through wartime Kweiyang and Kunming to America, who at twenty-nine with Chen-Ning Yang overthrew parity conservation, a law the physics world held universally valid, and at thirty-one became the youngest Nobel laureate of his age; for half a century he held his post at Columbia, pushing particle physics from the theta-tau puzzle to relativistic heavy-ion collisions under the single theme of symmetry and its breaking, and in his late years sent nearly a thousand young Chinese physicists across the ocean through the CUSPEA examinations — proof that the deepest physics is often where symmetry fails
roles_zh: 中国高等科学技术中心创始人
roles_en: Founder, China Center of Advanced Science and Technology
key_works: 《弱相互作用中的宇称守恒质疑》（与杨振宁，1956）
《二维伊辛模型的自发磁化》（与杨振宁，1952）
《非拓扑性孤立子与孤立子星》（与 Friedberg，1970 年代）

cross_references.description_zh: 李政道与爱因斯坦同走'审讯公理'的路：爱因斯坦问'同时性到底是什么'，把物理学家用了两百年的概念拖上手术台；李政道问'宇称守恒在弱作用中被检验过吗'，把全行业默认的条款翻出对账——两人都不增加新实体，只对前提做审计——平行命题：一场革命的起点可以只是一个问题的检验记录缺失。
cross_references.description_en: Lee and Einstein walked the same road of interrogating axioms: Einstein asked what simultaneity actually is and put a concept two centuries of physicists had used onto the operating table; Lee asked whether parity had ever been tested in the weak interaction and audited a clause the whole profession took on faith — neither added a new entity; both audited premises — the parallel thesis: a revolution can begin with nothing more than a missing entry in the examination record of a question.

cross_references.description_zh: 李政道与朗道是理论物理的两种教主：朗道把标准变成制度——考试、研讨班、分级表，以入口的严苛定义学派；李政道把通道变成制度——CUSPEA、少年班、博士后，以出口的畅通定义桥梁——朗道的门越窄质量越高，李的桥越宽流向越多——对照命题：制度可以立法在入口（朗道），也可以立法在通道（李政道），但两者的共同点是：不把人才培养交给运气。
cross_references.description_en: Lee and Landau are two pontiffs of theoretical physics: Landau turned standards into institutions — examinations, seminars, a grading scale — defining his school by the severity of its entrance; Lee turned channels into institutions — CUSPEA, gifted classes, the postdoctoral system — defining a bridge by the openness of its exit; Landau's narrower gate meant higher quality, Lee's wider bridge meant greater flow — the contrast thesis: institutions may legislate at the entrance (Landau) or at the channel (Lee), but both share one conviction: never leave the making of talent to luck.

cross_references.description_zh: 李政道与费米是师生两代的'最小主义'：费米教他用计算器与纸把问题从头算到底——李在芝加哥时问一个白矮星问题，费米拉他做了一把 6 英尺长的计算尺；李政道后来审讯宇称时用的也是同一招：不搬大理论，找一个能当场算出的赝标量——平行命题：最小的可计算单元是对付最大教条的武器，这一武器在费米手里叫估算，在李政道手里叫检验记录。
cross_references.description_en: Lee and Fermi are minimalists of two generations, master and pupil: Fermi taught him to compute a problem from scratch on paper and slide rule — when Lee raised a white-dwarf question in Chicago, Fermi had the two of them build a six-foot slide rule; when Lee audited parity he used the same move: no grand theory, one pseudoscalar computable on the spot — the parallel thesis: the smallest computable unit is the weapon against the largest dogma; in Fermi's hand it was called estimation, in Lee's, the examination record.
